description: Everything bible.flogvit.com has about one chapter: summary, historical context, key words, the people in it, themes, stories, prophecies, gospel parallels and timeline events. Give a chapter ("Rom 8"); verses are ignored.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content: en, nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv, fr, es, fi, de. Content missing in a language falls back to English.

reference.description: Bible reference in English or Norwegian style, e.g. "John 3:16", "Joh 3,16-18", "1 Cor 13:4-7", "Ps 23", "Gen 1:1-2:3". Several separated by ";": "Rom 8:28; 9:1; John 3:16".

name: get_chapter_study
title: Study notes for a chapter
